definitions.explanation: A defensive wall surrounding a castle, fortress, or fortified city. Used for both Japanese castles and foreign historical fortifications.

examples.japanese: {城壁|じょうへき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦そびえている→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧。
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{城壁|じょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}えて→越える：02099_koeru⟧⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}した→侵入する：17343_shinnyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The enemy crossed the castle wall and invaded.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{築|きず}かれた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧{城壁|じょうへき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれていて→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This town is surrounded by castle walls built in the Middle Ages and is popular with tourists.

notes:
Compound of {城|じょう} (castle) and {壁|へき} (wall). Refers to the outer defensive walls of a castle or fortified settlement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {城壁|じょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build castle walls
- {城壁|じょうへき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: surrounded by castle walls
- {城壁|じょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb the castle wall
- {城壁|じょうへき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧: ruins of castle walls

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧: stone wall — specifically the stone foundations and walls of Japanese castles
- ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧: castle — the entire castle structure
- ⟦{堀|ほり}→堀：03725_hori⟧: moat — the water-filled trench surrounding a castle
- ⟦{砦|とりで}→砦：24127_toride⟧: fortress, stronghold — a smaller defensive structure
